about: Account usage-limit readings, given by hand: no session can read the weekly limit programmatically (Dinis, 22 Nov 2026). Dinis, or an agent he tells, gives the percentage; accountant.d appends it here and relates it to the tokens measured in the same period. Append only. A row without a source is not a row.
how_to_give: Say, in any account D session or here: 'account <letter>, weekly <n>%, resets <time if known>'. The session passes it to accountant.d, or Dinis tells me directly.

readings.source: Dinis, by hand, in accountant.d's session, from the usage screen
readings.api_equiv_usd_read_same_time: none yet: first lifetime snapshot 13:30Z gave 385.84 for 18 sessions since 21 Nov 22:11Z (a floor: sessions not read are missing)
readings.note: first reading; the tokens-per-percent ratio needs two readings with a token reading at each

derived.method: between two readings of the same account and window: (API-equivalent cost or tokens measured by get_session for every session of that account) / (change in percent). Needs the reset boundary respected: a drop in percent means a reset, not a refund.
